versions.text: Criterion: Verify (if required for proper operation of ice protection equipment) that monitoring of external surfaces can be accomplished by the crew throughout the design envelope. Standard: No single environmental protection subsystem failure (including control station functions that are critical to air vehicle flight safety) results in flying qualities less than level three or loss of aircraft. Method of Compliance: The standard is verified by the following activities: a. Analysis and/or simulation determine the severity of the environment that drives protection needs for the air vehicle system. b. Capability analysis and test verify the adequacy of environmental protection system mechanisms required for air vehicle system safety of flight profile. c. FMECA and hazard analysis including the control station verifies that any failure of the environmental protection subsystem does not affect safety of flight operations. References: JSSG-2009: D.3.4.4.11, D.4.4.4.11 Ice protection 14 CFR 23.1419, 25.1419, 27.1419, 29.1419
